elements.text:
You've been talking to your crush on Snapchat and they're usually quick to respond. You see that they opened your message a couple of hours ago and did not respond. 

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: My crush must have a lot to do today.
If my crush likes someone else and not me, I won't like it, but I can handle it.
My crush will get back to me when they have time.
Maybe I'm annoying my crush, but they also might be busy.
My crush will never respond to me.
